title: Remove a Tipper (LOTO + disconnect power/air/Ethernet/conduit) for Tipper Replacement
summary: Safely remove a failed OptiSweep tipper from its station by applying lockout/tagout (LOTO) and disconnecting the tipper’s power (6-pin Molex), Ethernet (ClearLink controller), air line (quick disconnect), and the conduit bringing power/air/Ethernet to the column. Optionally remove the gripper and counter-balance weights before unbolting the tipper.
when_to_use: Use when a tipper must be physically removed for replacement and the documented removal connections (power, Ethernet, air, and conduit) must be safely disconnected after LOTO.
not_for: Do not use as a troubleshooting procedure for tipper alarms/heartbeat without performing the physical removal steps.
Do not use if you cannot complete LOTO or cannot safely disconnect any of the required connections as described.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: perform physical LOTO and disconnection of tipper connections; support the tipper during unbolting.
safety_notes: Apply LOTO to the tipper before disconnecting power/Ethernet/air/conduit.
Keep the tipper supported while removing the mounting screws.
access_or_tools_needed: Physical access to the tipper station
Replacement part: Tipper (for later installation step; removal uses the existing tipper)
3/8-in. wrench or socket (if side panel removal is necessary)
Tools to remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing screws for the side panel (if needed)
Tools to remove the four (4) hex head screws holding the tipper to the sub-plate

access_required: Physical access to the tipper station
system_preconditions: Tipper is isolated via LOTO before any disconnection steps.

steps.title: Apply LOTO to the tipper
steps.purpose: Ensure the tipper is safely isolated before any disconnection work.
steps.instruction: Perform lockout/tagout (LOTO) on the tipper using the operator station lockout/tagout controls referenced by the manual.
steps.expected_result: LOTO is applied to the tipper (tipper is isolated) before proceeding to disconnect power/Ethernet/air/conduit.
steps.healthy_condition: LOTO is in place and you can proceed with disconnection steps without needing to energize or operate the tipper.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot complete LOTO on the tipper.

actions.label: Perform LOTO on tipper
actions.exact_action: LOTO the tipper (see "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" on page 2).

screens_or_images.what_to_look_at: Manual-referenced operator station lockout/tagout controls/location (image not included in this packet).

stop_or_escalate_if: You cannot complete LOTO on the tipper.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.22.1: REMOVAL steps 1-9 include: "LOTO the tipper (see \"Operator Station Lockout/Tagout\" on page 2)."

steps.title: Remove station side panel (if necessary) to access the motor
steps.purpose: Provide access to internal components (motor/control box area) needed for subsequent disconnections.
steps.instruction: If necessary, use a 3/8-in. wrench or socket to remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing screws for the side panel, then remove the station side panel to access the motor.
steps.expected_result: Station side panel is removed and the motor area is accessible.
steps.healthy_condition: All nine (9) self-tapping securing screws are removed and the side panel is off without forcing or damaging surrounding components.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot remove the side panel screws safely or the panel cannot be removed to access the motor.

actions.label: Check if side panel removal is necessary
actions.exact_action: If necessary, use a 3/8-in. wrench or socket to remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing screws for the side panel, then remove the station side panel to access the motor.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Removal step: "If necessary, use a 3/8-in. wrench or socket to remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing screws for the side panel, then remove the station side panel to access the motor."
Figure 7-19 nearby text includes: "If necessary, use a 3/8-in. wrench or socket to remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing the side panel then remove the station side panel to access the motor."

steps.title: Disconnect control box power (6-pin Molex) and push cable into the column
steps.purpose: De-energize the tipper control box by disconnecting the documented power connector.
steps.instruction: Remove the control box and disconnect the power cable from the control box using the 6-pin Molex connector, then push the cable into the column.
steps.expected_result: Power cable is disconnected from the control box (6-pin Molex) and the cable is pushed into the column.
steps.healthy_condition: The 6-pin Molex power connector is fully unplugged and the cable is routed away from the tipper for safe removal.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot safely disconnect the power cable from the control box as described.

actions.label: Disconnect 6-pin Molex power
actions.exact_action: Disconnect the power cable from the control box (6-pin Molex connector), then push the cable into the column.

stop_or_escalate_if: Any connection (power/ethernet/air/conduit) cannot be safely disconnected as described.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Removal step: "Remove the control box and disconnect the power cable from the control box (6-pin Molex connector), then push the cable into the column."

steps.title: Unplug Ethernet from the ClearLink controller and push into the column
steps.purpose: Remove network connectivity to the tipper by disconnecting Ethernet at the ClearLink controller.
steps.instruction: Unplug the Ethernet cable from the ClearLink controller and push the Ethernet cable into the column.
steps.expected_result: Ethernet cable is unplugged from the ClearLink controller and routed/pushed into the column.
steps.healthy_condition: Ethernet connector is fully unplugged without bending pins; cable is secured/routed into the column.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot safely unplug the Ethernet cable from the ClearLink controller as described.

actions.label: Unplug Ethernet
actions.exact_action: Unplug the Ethernet cable from the ClearLink controller and push the Ethernet cable into the column.

stop_or_escalate_if: Any connection (power/ethernet/air/conduit) cannot be safely disconnected as described.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Removal step: "Unplug the Ethernet cable from the ClearLink controller and push the Ethernet cable into the column."

steps.title: Disconnect air line at the quick disconnect (leave quick disconnect with tipper side of air line)
steps.purpose: Isolate pneumatic supply by disconnecting the air line at the quick disconnect.
steps.instruction: Disconnect the air line at the quick disconnect at the bottom of the column, leaving the quick disconnect with the tipper side of the air line.
steps.expected_result: Air line is disconnected at the quick disconnect; the quick disconnect remains on the tipper side of the air line.
steps.healthy_condition: Quick disconnect separation is clean and the tipper-side quick disconnect is retained as specified.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot safely disconnect the air line at the quick disconnect as described.

actions.label: Disconnect air line
actions.exact_action: Disconnect the air line at the quick disconnect at the bottom of the column, leaving the quick disconnect with the tipper side of the air line.

stop_or_escalate_if: Any connection (power/ethernet/air/conduit) cannot be safely disconnected as described.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Removal step: "Disconnect the air line at the quick disconnect at the bottom of the column, leaving the quick disconnect with the tipper side of the air line."

steps.title: Tape air line openings to prevent debris
steps.purpose: Prevent debris from entering the pneumatic line openings after disconnection.
steps.instruction: Add tape over the air line and quick disconnect to prevent debris from entering either side of the air line.
steps.expected_result: Tape is applied over the air line and quick disconnect openings on both sides to block debris ingress.
steps.healthy_condition: Openings are fully covered with tape and no gaps are left that could allow debris entry.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot apply tape such that openings remain exposed.

actions.label: Tape openings
actions.exact_action: Add tape over the air line and quick disconnect to prevent debris from entering either side of the air line.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Removal step: "Add tape over the air line and quick disconnect to prevent debris from entering either side of the air line."

steps.title: Fully disconnect conduit bringing power/air/Ethernet to the column and pull cables free from the tipper
steps.purpose: Free the tipper from the column by disconnecting the combined conduit connections.
steps.instruction: Fully disconnect the conduit bringing power, air, and Ethernet to the column and pull these cables free from the tipper.
steps.expected_result: Conduit connections are freed from the tipper and the power/air/Ethernet cables are pulled free from the tipper.
steps.healthy_condition: Cables are disconnected and clear of the tipper without strain; conduit is fully disconnected at the tipper interface.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot safely disconnect the conduit or pull the cables free as described.

actions.label: Disconnect conduit and free cables
actions.exact_action: Fully disconnect the conduit bringing power, air, and Ethernet to the column and pull these cables free from the tipper.

stop_or_escalate_if: Any connection (power/ethernet/air/conduit) cannot be safely disconnected as described.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Removal step: "Fully disconnect the conduit bringing power, air, and Ethernet to the column and pull these cables free from the tipper."

steps.title: Optional: remove gripper and counter-balance weights
steps.purpose: Reduce imbalance and improve safety/ease of unbolting the tipper.
steps.instruction: Optional but recommended: remove the gripper (see Gripper Replacement) and the counter-balance weights (see Counter-balance weights) before unbolting the tipper.
steps.expected_result: Gripper and counter-balance weights are removed (if you choose to perform the optional steps).
steps.healthy_condition: System is balanced/handled safely for the next step (tipper unbolting) with no unsafe drift.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot remove the gripper/counter-balance weights safely or doing so creates an unsafe condition.

actions.label: Remove gripper and counter-balance weights (optional)
actions.exact_action: Optional but recommended: remove the gripper (see Gripper Replacement) and the counter-balance weights (see Counter-balance weights).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Removal step: "Optional but recommended: remove the gripper (see Gripper Replacement) and the counter-balance weights (see Counter-balance weights)."

steps.title: Remove four hex head screws holding tipper to sub-plate (tipper supported)
steps.purpose: Detach the tipper from the sub-plate while maintaining safe support.
steps.instruction: With the tipper supported, remove the four (4) hex head screws holding the tipper to the sub-plate.
steps.expected_result: All four (4) hex head screws are removed while the tipper remains supported.
steps.healthy_condition: Tipper does not shift or drop during screw removal; support is maintained until screws are out.
steps.failure_condition: Tipper cannot be supported safely while removing the four (4) hex head screws.

actions.label: Unbolt tipper from sub-plate
actions.exact_action: With the tipper supported, remove the four (4) hex head screws holding the tipper to the sub-plate.

stop_or_escalate_if: The tipper cannot be supported safely while removing the four (4) hex head screws.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Removal step: "With the tipper supported, remove the four (4) hex head screws holding the tipper to the sub-plate."

success_criteria: LOTO is applied to the tipper.
Power is disconnected at the control box using the 6-pin Molex connector and the cable is pushed into the column.
Ethernet is unplugged from the ClearLink controller and pushed into the column.
Air line is disconnected at the quick disconnect at the bottom of the column with the quick disconnect left on the tipper side.
Tape is applied over the air line and quick disconnect openings to prevent debris ingress.
Conduit bringing power/air/Ethernet to the column is fully disconnected and cables are pulled free from the tipper.
Four (4) hex head screws are removed while the tipper remains supported.
healthy_conditions: All required connections (power, Ethernet, air, conduit) are disconnected without unsafe strain or exposed openings (air openings taped).
failure_conditions: LOTO cannot be completed on the tipper.
Any connection (power/ethernet/air/conduit) cannot be safely disconnected as described.
Tipper cannot be supported safely while removing the four (4) hex head screws.
escalation_guidance: Stop and escalate if you cannot complete LOTO or if any connection cannot be safely disconnected as described.
Stop and escalate if the tipper cannot be supported safely while removing the four (4) hex head screws.
